themes.name: Agentic AI in research

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools and research focused on assisting developers with writing, debugging, and understanding code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad range of AI-powered tools designed to aid in the research process, from data analysis to literature review.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Articles discussing the capabilities, limitations, and impact of AI chatbots, particularly in user interaction and support.

themes.name: AI sentiment & feedback analysis
themes.description: Examines how AI is used to analyze user sentiment, feedback, and opinions from various sources.

themes.name: AI survey tools

themes.description: Explores how AI tools and techniques can assist product managers in their daily workflows and decision-making.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: Covers research into how AI impacts job markets, hiring processes, and the future of work.
